Because the Hampton confirmation shows a prepaid rate, verify that shortening the stay produces a refund or adjusted charge before approving the modification.
So there is no date problem on the conference reservation itself?

Correct. The Hyatt dates are the intended Sunday-through-Wednesday conference stay. The exact correction is to remove Sunday night from the Hampton booking and retain its Saturday check-in; do not cancel, rebook, or alter the Hyatt reservation.
